title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (11/20): The Dalian Bay Undersea Tunnel
note_en: 一边…一边… describes two actions going on at the same time: 一边在干坞预制巨大的沉管节段，一边在海底开挖基槽 "prefabricating huge tunnel sections in a dry dock while dredging a trench on the seabed." English joins the two with "while" or "at the same time," but Chinese marks both actions with 一边, which can describe a whole team's parallel work, not just one person doing two things at once.
